svg.title: More work. Less weight.
svg.desc: Matched single-worker fixture · three complete paired repeats. 1.32–1.47×: More tasks per second; Same WebKit workload; 82%–84%: Less sampled peak memory; Daemon + responsible helpers. All measured tasks and warmups succeeded in each pair. Whole-grid targets remain unmet; heavy matched runs hit the RAM guard.
